categories.label: Filing Formalities
categories.prompt: Assess Form 28 for this SLP (Civil): court and jurisdiction caption, party positions, the petition body, mandatory declarations, grounds, prayers, and any supporting affidavit this task names. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score other Form 28 points, other categories, or legal merit.

categories.label: Advocate's Check List
categories.prompt: Assess the Advocate's Check List and the Advocate-on-Record's certificate on this filing, including the signature block. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Listing Proforma
categories.prompt: Assess the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) that accompanies the filing. Decide only whether the columns or particulars named in this task are duly filled. Do not score other listing fields unless this task names them.

categories.label: Petition Presentation
categories.prompt: Assess the form of the petition: paper, spacing, font, margins, numbering, signatures and endorsements. Decide only the objection in the user message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Applications
categories.prompt: Assess interlocutory or miscellaneous applications named in this task (condonation, substitution, caveat, permission to appear). Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Annexures
categories.prompt: Assess the annexures: markings, true copies, order, and match to the Index or List of Dates. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Parties and Cause Title
categories.prompt: Assess the cause title, Memo of Parties, and party particulars named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Drafting and Execution Dates
categories.prompt: Assess the drafting date of the petition relative to filing, the supporting affidavit and the Vakalatnama. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Index and Paper Book
categories.prompt: Assess the common index, running pagination, and Part I / Part II (or volume) arrangement of the paper book. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Limitation
categories.prompt: Assess the Office Report on Limitation and any condonation of delay for a time-barred petition named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Affidavit
categories.prompt: Assess the supporting affidavit named in this task: presence, form, swearing, exhibits and blanks. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Translations
categories.prompt: Assess translations of vernacular documents, official translation or exemption, and translated powers of attorney. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Vakalatnama
categories.prompt: Assess the Vakalatnama: execution, acceptance, executant particulars and related endorsements. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Memo of Appearance
categories.prompt: Assess the Memo of Appearance named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: List of Dates
categories.prompt: Assess the List of Dates and Events named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

defects.defect: An application for condonation of delay has not been filed for an interlocutory or miscellaneous application filed after the applicable limitation.
defects.requirement: Where limitation has not been prescribed by the Supreme Court Rules or any other provision of law, every interlocutory or miscellaneous application shall be filed within thirty days from the date of the order or the cause. If it is filed after that period, it shall be accompanied by an application for condonation of delay.
where_to_look: Check the Record of Proceedings or order in the main case for the date of the order, and compare it with the date of filing of the interlocutory or miscellaneous application.
Check the applications placed after the Annexures for an application for condonation of delay filed along with that application.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to confirm whether the interlocutory or miscellaneous application is being filed beyond the prescribed period. If so, option for Jubeex to auto-generate the application for condonation of delay.
Option for the User to upload the application for condonation of delay with Jubeex.

defects.defect: A photocopy or typed authenticated copy of a judgment referred to in the impugned order and reported in a local law journal has not been filed.
defects.requirement: A copy of a judgment referred to in the impugned order and reported in a journal need not be filed, except where it has been reported in a local law journal, in which case a photocopy or a typed authenticated copy shall be filed.
where_to_look: Check the Impugned Order for any judgment referred to in it and note its citation, parties and date.
Check the Index and the Annexures for a photocopy or typed authenticated copy of that reported judgment.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the photocopy or typed authenticated copy of the judgment referred to in the impugned order and reported in a local law journal.

defects.defect: A judicial officer who disposed of the case in the court below is impleaded as a party in the main case.
defects.requirement: No judicial officer who has disposed of the case in the court below shall be impleaded as a party in the main case.
where_to_look: Check the cause title on the first page of the main petition and the Memo of Parties for the array of respondents.
Check whether any respondent is described as a Judge, Judicial Officer or Presiding Officer of the court below; cross-check the name against the judge who passed the impugned order.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-edit and remove the name of such judicial officer, where arrayed as a contesting respondent.
Option for the User to edit the document.

defects.defect: The case file or paper book does not have one common index with running pagination corresponding to the documents and applications to be kept in Part I, or the applications to be listed are not placed in Part I and Part II respectively.
defects.requirement: The case file or paper book shall have one common index with running pagination as per the prescribed column, corresponding to the documents and applications to be kept in Part I. Applications to be listed before the Court and the Judge in Chambers or Court of Registrar must be placed in Part I and Part II respectively.
where_to_look: Check the Index at the beginning of the case file for a single common index covering the whole paper book.
Check whether the documents forming Part I and the applications to be listed in Part II are placed in their respective parts, as shown in the Index columns.
Check the page numbers running through the file against the Index.
how_to_cure: Common index with running pagination: option for Jubeex to auto-generate the common index and pagination.
Option for the User to edit with Jubeex.
Re-upload the amended document.
Arrangement of Part I and Part II: option for Jubeex to auto-rearrange the documents into Part I and Part II.
Option for the User to rearrange the documents.
Re-upload the amended document.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D014. D014 covers one common index and Part I / Part II arrangement for the paper book. This check is only whether multi-volume files have a common index in volume 1 and a separate index in each volume. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: A common index has not been placed in the first volume where there is more than one volume, or a separate index of each volume is not placed in that volume.
defects.requirement: A common index shall be placed in the first volume where there is more than one volume, and a separate index of each volume shall be placed in the respective volume.
where_to_look: Check whether the case file runs into more than one volume (the Index will show the volume divisions and the page ranges).
Check the first volume for a common index covering all volumes.
Check each volume for its own separate index placed at its beginning.
how_to_cure: Common index in the first volume: option for Jubeex to auto-generate the common index for all volumes and place it in the first volume.
Option for the User to upload the common index with Jubeex.
Separate index for each volume: option for Jubeex to auto-generate a separate index for each volume.
Option for the User to upload the index of each volume with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: F.No.01/Judl./2020, SCI_CIRCULAR_2020, Page 2 of the PDF

defects.defect: The Advocate-on-Record has not filed the requisite checklist in the prescribed format along with the petition or appeal.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record must file a checklist along with every petition. The checklist must be in accordance with the prescribed format.
where_to_look: Check the front of the case file, before the Cover Page and the Office Report on Limitation, for the Advocate's Checklist.
Check whether it is in the prescribed format, i.e. the numbered list of requirements each marked YES/NO/N.A., followed by the AOR's declaration.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the Advocate's Check List in the prescribed format.
Option for the User to upload the Advocate's Check List with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition along with the Advocate's Check List.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D003. D003 covers whether the Advocate's Check List was filed in the prescribed format. This check is only whether the Advocate-on-Record's personal-verification certification is on the Check List. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The Advocate-on-Record has not certified on the Advocate's Check List that he has personally verified the petition and that it is in conformity with the Supreme Court Rules, 2013.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record shall certify on the Advocate's Check List that he has personally verified the petition and that it is in conformity with the Supreme Court Rules, 2013; that the requirements of the Advocate's Check List have been complied with; and that all documents necessary for the hearing have been filed.
where_to_look: Check the Advocate's Check List at the very front of the case file (before the Cover Page).
Check the declaration at the end of the Check List for the Advocate-on-Record's certification that he has personally verified the petition and that it conforms to the Supreme Court Rules, 2013.
Check that the declaration is signed by the Advocate-on-Record and dated.
how_to_cure: Advocate's Check List: option for Jubeex to auto-generate and populate the Advocate's Check List.
Option for the User to add and edit the Advocate's Check List with Jubeex.
Upload the completed Advocate's Check List with Jubeex.

Advocate-on-Record's certification: prompt the User to obtain the Advocate-on-Record's certification and signature on the Advocate's Check List confirming personal verification of the petition, compliance with the Supreme Court Rules, 2013, compliance with the Check List, and that all necessary documents have been filed, and upload the duly certified Advocate's Check List with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D003. D003 is whether the Advocate's Check List was filed in the prescribed format. This check is only whether the Advocate-on-Record's code number appears in the certificate (checklist signature block and the certificate after Main Prayer), with a cross-check against the Vakalatnama. Do not re-decide whether the checklist exists.
defects.defect: The Advocate-on-Record's code number is not mentioned in the certificate.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record's code number must be mentioned in the certificate.
where_to_look: Check the Advocate's Check List at the front of the case file, in the signature block below the declaration.
Check for the Advocate-on-Record's code number stated alongside the Advocate-on-Record's name. Cross-check the same code against the Vakalatnama at the end of the file.
Also check the certificate found after the Main Prayer clause.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to provide the Advocate-on-Record's code number and auto-fill it in the Advocate-on-Record's certificate on the Advocate's Check List.
Option for the User to edit the Advocate-on-Record's code number in the certificate with Jubeex.
Re-upload the duly certified Advocate's Check List.
defects.location_source: Page 6, SCI_CHECKLIST_2025. End of Checklist contains signature block with Date, Signature of AOR, Name & Code of AOR

defects.defect: The Office Report on Limitation has not been filed.
defects.requirement: The Office Report on Limitation must be filed.
where_to_look: Go to the Office Report on Limitation (O/R on Limitation), usually located after the Index.

Check the front of the case file, after the Court Fees, for the Office Report on Limitation containing the statements as to whether the petition is within time and as to delay in filing and re-filing.
Follow the universal format for the Office Report.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the Office Report on Limitation.
defects.location_source: Source row did not give Location/Source.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D017. D017 covers whether the Office Report on Limitation was filed. This check is only whether a time-barred petition is accompanied by a condonation application stating the days of delay, with affidavit and court fee. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: Despite the petition being time-barred, an application seeking condonation of delay along with affidavit and court fee has not been filed.
defects.requirement: If the petition is time-barred, an application for condonation of delay stating the number of days of delay, with affidavit and court fee, must be filed.
where_to_look: Check the Office Report on Limitation at the front of the case file and compare the date of the impugned order with the date of filing to determine whether the petition is time-barred.
Check the applications placed after the Annexures for the application for condonation of delay, and verify that it states the number of days of delay.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to confirm the relevant dates, and option for Jubeex to calculate the number of days of delay (where feasible) and draft the application for condonation of delay using the calculated delay.
Option for the User to upload the duly completed application with Jubeex.

defects.defect: The petition or interlocutory application does not contain the complete residential or office addresses of the parties.
defects.requirement: Every petition or interlocutory application should contain complete residential or office addresses of the parties.
where_to_look: Check the cause title on the first page of the main petition and of the interlocutory application.
Check the Memo of Parties for the complete residential or office addresses of all parties, including street, city and PIN code.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to provide the complete residential and/or office addresses of all the parties, and auto-fill the same in the petition or interlocutory application with Jubeex.
Option for the User to edit the addresses of the parties with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition or interlocutory application.
defects.location_source: F.No. 94/Judl./2012 dated 23 April 2012, Page 130 of the PDF SCI_JUDICIAL_I_COMPENDIUM

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D019. D019 covers complete residential or office addresses of the parties. This check is only whether those addresses (and representatives' addresses) are complete and properly set out with relationship, locality and PIN code. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: Addresses of the parties and their representatives are not complete and are set out improperly.
defects.requirement: Addresses of the parties and their representatives must be complete and set out properly.
where_to_look: Check the cause title on the first page of the main petition.
Check the Memo of Parties for complete addresses of the parties and of their representatives, properly set out with the relationship (S/o, W/o), house or ward number, locality, city and PIN code.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to identify incomplete or improperly formatted addresses of the parties and their representatives, prompt the User to complete or correct the missing particulars, and auto-format the addresses in the prescribed format in the Memo of Parties.
Option for the User to re-upload the Memo of Parties.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D019. D019 covers complete addresses of the parties. This check is only the proper department and address for service on the Union of India or a State Government. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The petitioner fails to specify the proper department and address of the Union of India or the State Government on and through whom notice is required to be served, when they are a party to the case.
defects.requirement: The petitioner must specify the proper department and address of the Union of India or the State Government on and through whom notice is required to be served, when they are a party to the case.
where_to_look: Check the cause title of the main petition and the details of parties stated in the Memo of Parties for any respondent described as the Union of India or a State Government.
Check whether the specific Ministry or Department and its complete address, through which notice is to be served, is stated.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to enter the proper department and address of the Union of India or the State Government on whom notice is required to be served, and option for Jubeex to fill the Memo of Parties or cause title (or other relevant document) using the information provided.
Option for the User to edit the Memo of Parties or cause title with Jubeex.

defects.defect: The petition, appeal or interlocutory application is not accompanied by a proper and duly sworn affidavit in support of the allegations of fact made therein.
defects.requirement: No petition, appeal or interlocutory application is to be registered unless it is accompanied by a proper and duly sworn affidavit in support of the allegations of fact made therein.
where_to_look: Check for an affidavit filed immediately after the main petition or application (after the Advocate-on-Record's certificate) in support of the allegations of fact made in it.
Check the attestation and the notarial seal at the end of the affidavit to confirm it is duly sworn.

If an affidavit is filed separately along with an interlocutory application that is not part of the main petition, check the cause title; it should identify that interlocutory application in the main case.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the affidavit in support of the allegations of fact and prompt the User to have it duly sworn and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
Option for the User to upload the affidavit with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition, appeal or interlocutory application along with the affidavit.
defects.location_source: F.No.57/Judl./2009 dated 3 August 2009, Page 5 of the PDF SCI_CIRCULARS_GUIDELINES_COMPENDIUM

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only the form of that affidavit (first person, numbered paragraphs, deponent's particulars). Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The affidavit is not drawn up in the first person, is not divided into consecutively numbered paragraphs, or does not state the description, occupation (if any) and true place of abode of the deponent.
defects.requirement: Every affidavit shall be drawn up in the first person, divided into paragraphs numbered consecutively, and shall state the description, occupation (if any) and true place of abode of the deponent.
where_to_look: Look for an affidavit, usually following the main petition.
Check the opening line of the affidavit for first-person drafting ('I, [name]…') and for the deponent's description, occupation and true place of abode.
Check that the body of the affidavit is divided into consecutively numbered paragraphs.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft a fresh affidavit, prompt the User to have it duly sworn, and provide an option for the User to upload the duly sworn affidavit.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether the affidavit is confined to facts within the deponent's personal knowledge. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The affidavit contains matters beyond the deponent's personal knowledge.
defects.requirement: Affidavits shall be confined to such facts as the deponent is able of his own knowledge to prove.
where_to_look: Look for an affidavit, usually following the main petition.

Check the body of the affidavit for a statement that the facts are within the deponent's personal knowledge (for example that the deponent has gone through the accompanying petition and that the statements of fact are true to knowledge, and legal submissions are believed true on legal advice).
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft a fresh affidavit, prompt the User to have it duly sworn, and provide an option for the User to upload the duly sworn affidavit.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether it was sworn before a permitted authority. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The affidavit is not sworn before the appropriate authority.
defects.requirement: Affidavits for any cause, appeal or matter before the Court must be sworn before a Notary or any authority mentioned in section 139 of the Code, or before a Registrar of the Supreme Court duly authorised in this behalf by the Chief Justice, or before an Oath Commissioner generally or specially authorised in that behalf by the Chief Justice.
where_to_look: Look for an affidavit, usually following the main petition.
Go to the attestation or sworn portion and identify the authority before whom it was sworn.
Verify that the authority is one permitted by the stated rule, and that the affidavit is attested at the same place where the deponent is situated.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to ensure that the affidavit is sworn before a Notary, an authority specified under Section 139 of the Code, a duly authorised Registrar of the Supreme Court, or an Oath Commissioner authorised by the Chief Justice, and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether exhibits to that affidavit are marked, initialled and dated by the swearing authority. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: Exhibits to the affidavit are not marked, initialled and dated by the authority before whom they are sworn.
defects.requirement: Every exhibit annexed to an affidavit shall be marked with the title and number of the cause, appeal or matter and shall be initialled and dated by the authority before whom it is sworn.
where_to_look: Look for the exhibits to the Affidavit.
Check each such exhibit for the marking, initials and date of the authority before whom the affidavit was sworn (usually at the top or foot of each exhibit page).
how_to_cure: Marking of exhibits: option for Jubeex to auto-mark each exhibit annexed to the affidavit with the title and number of the cause, appeal or matter.
Option for the User to review and edit the exhibit markings with Jubeex.
Re-upload the affidavit along with the marked exhibits.

Prompt the User to ensure that each exhibit annexed to the affidavit is initialled and dated by the authority before whom the affidavit is sworn, and upload the duly initialled and dated exhibits with Jubeex.
Re-upload the affidavit along with the duly initialled and dated exhibits.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 15 of the PDF SCI_RULES_2013

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether interlineations, alterations or erasures are initialled as required. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The affidavit has an interlineation, alteration or erasure that is not initialled, or rewritten in the margin and initialled, by the authority before whom it is sworn.
defects.requirement: No affidavit having any interlineation, alteration or erasure shall be filed unless the interlineation or alteration is initialled by the authority, or in case of erasure the words or figures are rewritten in the margin and initialled by the authority before whom the affidavit is sworn.
where_to_look: Look for an affidavit, usually following the main petition.
Where an interlineation or alteration exists, check for the authority's initials.
Where there is an erasure, check that the words or figures are rewritten in the margin and initialled by the authority.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to flag any interlineations, alterations or erasures in the affidavit and prompt the User to have them duly initialled by the authority before whom the affidavit is sworn.
Option for the User to prepare a fresh affidavit with Jubeex and upload the re-sworn affidavit.
Re-upload the affidavit.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether each affidavit states the date on which it was sworn. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: A document such as an affidavit, affidavit in opposition or rejoinder affidavit does not mention the date on which it was sworn before the notary or oath commissioner.
defects.requirement: On an affidavit, affidavit in opposition, rejoinder affidavit or similar document, the date on which it is sworn before the notary or oath commissioner must be mentioned on the affidavit.
where_to_look: Go to the relevant affidavit. Check the first page for the verification or attestation details and look for a specific date on which the affidavit was sworn or affirmed.
If the date is not on the first page, check the subsequent or final page containing the deponent's signature and the Oath Commissioner, Notary or authorised officer.
Repeat the same check for each affidavit filed in the matter, including an affidavit in opposition, rejoinder, additional affidavit or any other affidavit.
how_to_cure: Flag that the date of swearing is missing from the affidavit, prompt the User to have the affidavit re-sworn with the date duly mentioned, and provide an option to upload the duly re-sworn affidavit with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether the affidavit body and affirmation clause have any unfilled blanks. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The affidavit contains a blank portion in the body or in the affirmation clause.
defects.requirement: Any blank portions in the body or in the affirmation clause of an affidavit must be duly filled.
where_to_look: Review every page of the affidavit, including the body and the final page containing the verification or affirmation and attestation.
In the body, look for blank spaces, empty fields, underscores, brackets, dotted lines or placeholders, including names, dates, case numbers, paragraph references, parties, amounts or places.
Check the affirmation or verification clause for any blank relating to the date, place, name of the deponent or other particulars.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the duly completed and re-sworn affidavit with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D021. D021 covers whether a duly sworn supporting affidavit accompanies the petition or application. This check is only whether that affidavit is headed in the same cause, appeal or matter. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The affidavit is not filed in the cause, appeal or matter for which it is sworn.
defects.requirement: Every affidavit shall be filed in the cause, appeal or matter for which it is sworn.
where_to_look: Check each affidavit filed in the matter.
Go to the cause title or heading of each affidavit.
Verify that the cause, appeal or matter stated in the affidavit corresponds to the case in which it has been filed.
Cross-check the case number and party names against the main petition or appeal.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate a fresh affidavit with the correct case particulars and prompt the User to have it duly sworn and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
Option for the User to upload a re-sworn affidavit.

defects.defect: The Vakalatnama from the respondent(s) is not accompanied by a caveat, though the matter is neither admitted nor is notice issued.
defects.requirement: Where a matter is neither admitted nor is notice issued, a Vakalatnama from the respondent(s) can only be filed when accompanied by a caveat, wherever a caveat is permitted under the Supreme Court Rules, 2013.
where_to_look: Check if a caveat on behalf of the respondent has been attached to the file.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to confirm whether the matter has been admitted or notice has been issued. If not, and a caveat is permissible, option for Jubeex to auto-generate the caveat.
Option for the User to add and edit the caveat with Jubeex.
Re-upload the respondent's Vakalatnama along with the caveat.
defects.location_source: No. F.37/Judl/2008 dated 21 November 2008, Page 41 of the PDF 2024042323-1.pdf. Also SCI_COURT_PROCESSES_HANDBOOK, Page 103 of the PDF

defects.defect: The pleading, petition, affidavit or other document (except original exhibits and certified copies of public documents) is not fairly or legibly written, or is typed in less than double-line spacing.
defects.requirement: Every pleading, petition, affidavit or other document (except original exhibits and certified copies of public documents) must be fairly and legibly written, type-written or lithographed in double-line spacing.
where_to_look: Check the main petition, the affidavit and every other document in the case file (except original exhibits and certified copies of public documents).
Check that each is fairly and legibly written or typed in double-line spacing, and is not a faint, skewed or partially cut scan.
For originals, it is advisable that a clear typed copy is annexed along with the original.
how_to_cure: Double spacing: option for Jubeex to auto-apply double spacing.
Option for the User to apply double spacing using Jubeex.
Re-upload option for the document.
Legible scans: option for Jubeex to OCR and create legible, clear versions of the pleading, petition, affidavit or other document.
Option for the User to re-upload the document with clear, sharp, legible scans.

defects.defect: The standard petition paper is not demy-foolscap size or 29.7 cm × 21 cm (A4); for petitions specifically, it is not standard A4 size with a quarter margin.

how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to identify any reference to the caste or religion of the parties in the Memo of Parties, prompt the User to review the same, and provide an option to remove such references.
Option for the User to remove or edit the references to caste or religion with Jubeex.
Re-upload the revised Memo of Parties.

defects.defect: Times New Roman, font size 14, in one-and-a-half line spacing (for quotations and indents, font size 12 in single line spacing) is not used for filing.
defects.requirement: Times New Roman, font size 14, in one-and-a-half line spacing (for quotations and indents, font size 12 in single line spacing) shall be used for filing.
where_to_look: Review the petition and other filing documents (except annexures).
Verify Times New Roman, size 14, with one-and-a-half line spacing; for quotations and indents, verify size 12 with single-line spacing.
how_to_cure: Font style and font size: option for Jubeex to auto-format the document in Times New Roman, with font size 14 for the main text and font size 12 for quotations and indented text.
Option for the User to edit the font style and font size with Jubeex.
Line spacing: option for Jubeex to auto-format the document in one-and-a-half line spacing, with single line spacing for quotations and indented text.
Option for the User to edit the line spacing with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: F.No.01/Judl./2020, SCI_CIRCULAR_2020, Page 1 of the PDF

defects.defect: A margin of 4 cm on the left and right and 2 cm on the top and bottom is not used for filing.
defects.requirement: A margin of 4 cm on the left and right and 2 cm on the top and bottom shall be used for filing.
where_to_look: Review the petition and other filing documents (except annexures).
Check for a margin of 4 cm on the left and right and 2 cm at the top and bottom.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-format the document with 4 cm left and right margins and 2 cm top and bottom margins.
Option for the User to edit the page margins with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: F.No.01/Judl./2020, SCI_CIRCULAR_2020, Page 1 of the PDF

defects.defect: The petition is not duly signed by the Advocate-on-Record or party-in-person at the required places, including the Declaration, Advocate's Check List, Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing), main petition, Advocate's Certificate, application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama, Memo of Appearance, and the last page of each annexure.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record is to sign each page digitally (Adobe Sign) at the required places, including the Declaration, Advocate's Check List, Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing), main petition, Advocate's Certificate, application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama, Memo of Appearance, and the last page of each annexure.
where_to_look: Check the Declaration, Advocate's Check List and Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) for the Advocate-on-Record's digital signature at the prescribed place(s).
Check each page of the main petition for the Advocate-on-Record's digital signature at the required place(s).
Check the Advocate's Certificate, application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama and Memo of Appearance for the required Advocate-on-Record digital signature.
Check the last page of each annexure for the Advocate-on-Record's digital signature.
Verify that the signatures are digitally affixed through Adobe Sign and appear at the prescribed signature locations.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to allow Jubeex to auto-fill a saved signature at the relevant places as specified, after User approval.
Option for the User to re-upload the petition.

defects.defect: A Memo of Parties has not been filed.
defects.requirement: A Memo of Parties must be filed.
where_to_look: Check the cause title of the main petition for the complete particulars of all parties, including their address and e-mail address. A phone number may be ignored.
Check the Memo of Parties for the complete particulars of all parties.

If a Memo of Parties has not been separately filed, but the cause title of the main petition contains complete particulars of all parties, including address and e-mail address (or an indication that the e-mail address is unavailable), treat the requirement of filing the Memo of Parties as complied with.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to fill the Memo of Parties using the information available in the case database and the details provided by the User.
Option for the User to upload the duly completed Memo of Parties with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D058. D058 covers whether a Memo of Parties was filed (or cause-title particulars stand in its place). This check is only whether the cause title matches the impugned judgment's parties. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The cause title does not correspond to the impugned judgment and the names of the parties therein.
defects.requirement: The cause title must correspond to the impugned judgment and the names of the parties therein.
where_to_look: Check the cause title on the first page of the main petition.
Compare the names, order and description of the parties in the main petition with the cause title of the impugned judgment, usually placed after the Synopsis and List of Dates.
While comparing, check for spelling variations, omitted or dropped respondents, and parties described as “through LRs”.
Also verify the status of the parties, as the roles of petitioner and respondent may change depending on which party has challenged the impugned judgment.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to compare the cause title with the impugned judgment, identify any discrepancies in the names of the parties, and, upon confirmation by the User, update the cause title accordingly.
If the cause title is not disclosing all the details, ask the User to upload the Memo of Parties of the impugned case, then allow an option to edit or auto-edit.
Option for the User to review and edit the cause title with Jubeex.
Re-upload the required page.

defects.defect: An application for bringing legal representatives on record, or an application for substitution, is not filed.
defects.requirement: When a party in the court below dies, an application for bringing legal representatives on record or an application for substitution must be filed.
where_to_look: Check the facts of the main petition and the details of parties in the Memo of Parties for any indication that a party in the court below has died (for example a party described as 'deceased' or 'through LRs').
Check the applications placed after the Annexures for an application for bringing legal representatives on record.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft the application for bringing legal representatives on record (with an option for the User to review and edit it).
Option for the User to upload the duly completed application and the supporting death certificate with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D061. D061 covers whether an application to bring legal representatives on record was filed. This check is only whether delay in that substitution is accompanied by a condonation application. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: An application for condonation of delay in seeking substitution is not filed.
defects.requirement: When a party in the court below dies, if the application for substitution is not filed within limitation, an application seeking condonation of delay in seeking substitution must be filed.
where_to_look: Check the main petition and Memo of Parties for any indication that a party in the court below has died, such as the party being described as “deceased” or “through LRs”.
If a party is deceased, check the main petition and Memo of Parties for the date of death and determine whether there has been any delay in seeking substitution.
Check the applications placed after the Annexures for an application seeking condonation of delay in filing the application for substitution.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft the application for condonation of delay in seeking substitution.
Option for the User to upload the duly completed application with Jubeex.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D062. D062 covers whether a condonation application in substitution was filed. This check is only whether that application states the date of death and addresses. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The application for condonation of delay in seeking substitution does not specify the date of death and addresses of the parties.
defects.requirement: When a party in the court below dies and an application for condonation of delay in seeking substitution is filed, the application must specify the date of death and addresses of the parties.
where_to_look: Check the application for condonation of delay in seeking substitution.
Check the body of that application for the date of death and for the complete addresses of the parties.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to enter the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the legal representatives, and option for Jubeex to fill the application using the information provided.
Option for the User to review and edit the application with Jubeex.
Re-upload the updated application.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D061. D061 covers whether the substitution application was filed. This check is only whether that application states date of death, relationship, age and addresses. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The application for bringing legal representatives on record does not specify the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the parties.
defects.requirement: When a party in the court below dies and an application for bringing legal representatives on record is filed, the application must specify the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the parties.
where_to_look: Check the application for bringing legal representatives on record for the date of death of the deceased party.
Check the application for the name and relationship of each proposed legal representative with the deceased party.
Check the particulars of each proposed legal representative for their age and complete address.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to enter the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the legal representatives, and option for Jubeex to fill the application using the information provided.
Option for the User to review and edit the application with Jubeex.
Re-upload the updated application.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D061. D061 covers bringing legal representatives on record after death of a party. This check is only whether an application to set aside abatement states date of death, relationship, age and addresses. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The application for setting aside abatement does not specify the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the parties.
defects.requirement: When a party in the court below dies and an application seeking setting aside of abatement is filed, the application must specify the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the parties.
where_to_look: Check the application for setting aside abatement.
Check the body of that application for the date of death, and for the relationship, age and complete addresses of the parties.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to enter the date of death, relationship, age and addresses of the legal representatives, and option for Jubeex to fill the application using the information provided.
Option for the User to re-upload the updated application.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D061. D061 covers whether substitution-related applications were filed. This check is only whether each such application is supported by an affidavit. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: An application for bringing legal representatives on record, an application for condonation of delay in seeking substitution, and/or an application for setting aside abatement is not filed along with an affidavit.
defects.requirement: When a party in the court below dies, any application for bringing legal representatives on record, for condonation of delay in seeking substitution, or for setting aside abatement must be filed along with an affidavit.
where_to_look: Look for the application for substitution, condonation of delay and setting aside abatement.

Check each such application for a supporting affidavit filed immediately after it. If filed with the main petition, check whether the affidavit includes a line as to the veracity of the application; if the application is filed separately, check that an affidavit is attached with it.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the affidavit and prompt the User to have it duly sworn and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
Option for the User to upload the affidavit with Jubeex.

defects.defect: An application for permission to appear has not been filed by the power of attorney holder.
defects.requirement: An application for permission to appear must be filed by the power of attorney holder.
where_to_look: Check the applications placed after the Annexures for an application by the power of attorney holder seeking permission to appear.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft the application for permission to appear by the power of attorney holder.
Option for the User to upload the duly completed application with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition along with the application.

defects.defect: The petitioner-in-person has not filed an application seeking permission to appear and argue in person, indicating reasons why he or she cannot engage an advocate, and whether he or she is willing to accept an advocate appointed by the Court.
defects.requirement: The petitioner-in-person must file an application seeking permission to appear and argue in person, indicating reasons why he or she cannot engage an advocate and whether he or she is willing to accept an advocate appointed by the Court.
where_to_look: Check the applications placed after the Annexures for an application seeking permission to appear and argue in person.
Check that the application states the reasons why the petitioner cannot engage an advocate and whether he is willing to accept an advocate appointed by the Court.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft the application for permission to appear and argue in person.
Option for the User to upload the duly completed application with Jubeex.

defects.defect: Particulars of the impugned judgment are not uniformly written in all documents.
defects.requirement: Particulars of the impugned judgment must be uniformly written in all documents.
where_to_look: Note the particulars of the impugned judgment from the cause title of the main petition.
Compare those particulars with the Index, Cover Page, Synopsis, List of Dates, Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) and prayer clause.
Cross-check all of them against the Impugned Judgment itself placed after the Synopsis and List of Dates.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to compare the particulars of the impugned judgment across all filing documents, identify and display any inconsistencies, and, upon confirmation by the User, synchronise the particulars across the Index, cause title, Synopsis, petition and other relevant documents.
Option for the User to edit the mismatched particulars with Jubeex.

defects.defect: Annexures referred to in the Index or List of Dates do not match the actual annexures.
defects.requirement: Annexures referred to in the Index or List of Dates must match the actual annexures.
where_to_look: Check the Index for the description of annexures along with their page numbers.
Check the List of Dates and Events for the annexures referred to, with their markings and page numbers.
Check the annexures actually filed against that list, verifying that each referred annexure exists, carries the same marking and falls at the stated page range.
how_to_cure: Edit the Index or List of Dates with Jubeex: the User may choose to edit and correct the Index or List of Dates directly through Jubeex.
Re-upload corrected documents: the User may choose to re-upload the corrected Index or List of Dates and the corresponding annexures after making the necessary corrections.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D071. D071 covers whether Index or List of Dates references match the annexures filed. This check is only whether those annexures are in chronological order as per the List of Dates. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: Annexures are not filed in chronological order as per the List of Dates or Index.
defects.requirement: Annexures must be filed in chronological order as per the List of Dates.
where_to_look: Check the List of Dates and note the chronological sequence of the relevant documents or events.
Trace each annexure and verify that the document filed corresponds to the document referred to in the petition.
Check the annexures in sequence and verify that they are arranged chronologically in accordance with the List of Dates.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-arrange and place the annexures in chronological order as per the List of Dates, and rename and paginate annexures in accordance with Index sync.
Option to re-upload annexures.

defects.defect: A List of Dates and Events has not been filed.
defects.requirement: A List of Dates and Events must be filed.
where_to_look: Check the case file before the Impugned Order for the List of Dates and Events set out date-wise in chronological order.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to draft the List of Dates and Events using the information available from the petition and uploaded documents.
Option for the User to upload the duly completed List of Dates and Events with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Source row did not give Location/Source.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D073. D073 covers whether a List of Dates and Events was filed. This check is only whether a lengthy list is either kept brief or accompanied by a permission application. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The List of Dates and Events filed is not brief, and an application seeking permission to file a lengthy List of Dates and Events has not been filed.
defects.requirement: The List of Dates and Events filed must be brief, or an application seeking permission to file a lengthy List of Dates and Events must be filed.
where_to_look: Check the List of Dates and Events placed after the Synopsis and verify the number of pages to determine whether it exceeds the prescribed page limit.

If it exceeds the prescribed page limit, check for an application titled or containing the words “Application for Permission to file lengthy LOD”, seeking exemption from filing a lengthy List of Dates and Events.
Go through the applications placed after the Annexures and look for an application with the subject “Application for Exemption”.
how_to_cure: Brief List of Dates and Events: option for Jubeex to review the List of Dates and Events and shorten it to a brief and concise format.
Option for the User to upload the List of Dates and Events with Jubeex.
Application for permission to file a lengthy List of Dates and Events: option for Jubeex to draft an application seeking exemption from filing a lengthy List of Dates and Events.
Option for the User to upload the application with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: SCI_COURT_PROCESSES_HANDBOOK, Page 96 of the PDF. Also SCI_CHECKLIST_2025, Page 5

defects.defect: The main petition and the application do not disclose whom the counsel is representing, that is, the petitioner or the respondent.
defects.requirement: The main petition and the application must disclose whom the counsel is representing, that is, the petitioner or the respondent.
where_to_look: Check at all required places for the signature and name of the counsel along with disclosure of whom they are representing.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to auto-edit with Jubeex.
Option for the User to edit with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Source row did not give Location/Source.

defects.defect: Annexures referred to in the petition are not true copies of the documents.
defects.requirement: Annexures referred to in the petition must be true copies of the documents.
where_to_look: Check each annexure for an endorsement or certification that it is a true copy of the document filed before the court below.
how_to_cure: Re-upload option for the correct true copy.
Option for the User to auto-fix with Jubeex (add the signatures where required and affix a stamp of “True Copy” at required places).

defects.defect: A complete Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) has not been filled in, or is not signed, or is not included at all.
defects.requirement: A complete Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) must be filled in, signed and included.
where_to_look: Check the Proforma for First Listing at the front of the case file, after the Office Report on Limitation.
Check that every column is filled and that it bears the signature of the Advocate-on-Record with the date.
how_to_cure: If the Listing Proforma is missing: option for Jubeex to auto-add and fill it.
Option for the User to upload the Listing Proforma.
If not signed: edit option to add a signature.
Re-upload the proforma with signature.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D068. D068 covers whether a complete Listing Proforma is included, filled and signed. This check is only whether columns 6 and 7 are duly filled. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: Columns 6 and 7 of the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) are not duly filled in.
defects.requirement: Columns 6 and 7 of the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) must be duly filled in.
where_to_look: Check the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing).
Confirm columns 6 and 7 of the Proforma for First Listing are duly filled.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to enter the information required for Columns 6 and 7 of the Listing Proforma/Proforma for First Listing, and option for Jubeex to fill the relevant columns using the information provided.
Option for the User to re-upload the Listing Proforma.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D004. D004 covers whether columns 6 and 7 of the Listing Proforma are duly filled. This check is only whether column 6 states complete particulars of identical Supreme Court matters. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: Complete particulars of identical matters which are pending or have been disposed of by the Supreme Court have not been given.
defects.requirement: If any identical matters are pending or have been disposed of by the Supreme Court, the complete particulars of such matters must be given.
where_to_look: Check column 6 of the Proforma for First Listing for the complete particulars of identical matters pending before or disposed of by this Court, including citation and case details.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to provide the complete particulars of any identical matters pending before or disposed of by the Supreme Court, and option for Jubeex to incorporate the particulars in the listing proforma.
Option for the User to edit the particulars with Jubeex.
